newsHighlights.title: 'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out
newsHighlights.summary: A British woman who had difficulty walking after a stroke discarded her wheelchair and walked with the help of a Chinese-made exoskeleton robot at the China Import and Export Fair.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位中风后行动不便的英国女性在中国进出口交易会上借助中国制造的外骨骼机器人，扔掉轮椅重新行走。

newsHighlights.title: US crackdown on tech counterproductive
newsHighlights.summary: Analysts argue that the US crackdown on technology is counterproductive, as restricting chip exports and打压 rivals only disrupts global supply chains and slows innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 分析人士指出，美国对科技领域的打压适得其反，限制芯片出口、压制对手只会扰乱全球供应链并拖慢创新步伐。

newsHighlights.title: Cultural heritage protection to be bolstered
newsHighlights.summary: China will step up cultural heritage protection over the next five years through systematic protection, legal safeguards and digital technologies that bring heritage closer to people's daily lives.
newsHighlights.translation: 未来五年，中国将通过系统性保护、法律保障以及数字技术，让文化遗产更贴近人们的日常生活。

newsHighlights.title: APEC economies urged to deepen cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: As a key growth engine, APEC economies are urged to uphold multilateralism, deepen open cooperation and unlock new growth momentum driven by science and technology.
newsHighlights.translation: 作为关键增长引擎，亚太经合组织各经济体被呼吁维护多边主义、深化开放合作，并释放由科技创新驱动的新增长动能。

quote.quote: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
quote.author: Arthur C. Clarke
quote.translation: 任何足够先进的科技，都与魔法无异。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们：真正领先的科技会让复杂的技术以近乎神奇的方式改变生活，正如新闻中的外骨骼机器人让瘫痪患者重新行走一样。

vocabulary.definition: 外骨骼；（用于辅助运动的）体外支撑装置
vocabulary.example: The Chinese-made exoskeleton robot helped the patient walk without a wheelchair.
vocabulary.translation: 中国制造的外骨骼机器人帮助这位患者在不借助轮椅的情况下行走。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出现在新闻 'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out 中，指中国进出口交易会上展示的外骨骼机器人。

vocabulary.definition: 移动能力；行动能力；流动性
vocabulary.example: A British woman suffering from hindered mobility after a stroke regained the ability to walk.
vocabulary.translation: 一位中风后行动能力受损的英国女性重新获得了行走的能力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻中用于描述中风后行动不便（hindered mobility）的英国女性。

vocabulary.example: China will bolster cultural heritage protection over the next five years.
vocabulary.translation: 中国将在未来五年加强文化遗产保护。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻 Cultural heritage protection to be bolstered 的标题。

vocabulary.definition: 适得其反的；产生反效果的
vocabulary.example: The US crackdown on technology is counterproductive and hurts global innovation.
vocabulary.translation: 美国对科技的打压适得其反，损害了全球创新。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 US crackdown on tech counterproductive 的标题。

vocabulary.example: APEC economies should unlock new growth momentum through technological cooperation.
vocabulary.translation: 亚太经合组织各经济体应通过科技合作释放新的增长动能。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻 APEC economies urged to deepen cooperation 中提到 unlock new growth momentum。

vocabulary.definition: 系统的；有条理的；有计划的
vocabulary.example: Officials called for systematic protection of cultural heritage supported by digital tools.
vocabulary.translation: 官员呼吁借助数字工具对文化遗产进行系统性保护。
vocabulary.newsContext: 文化遗产保护新闻中强调 systematic protection 与 legal safeguards。

vocabulary.example: Restricting chip exports only slows innovation in the global technology sector.
vocabulary.translation: 限制芯片出口只会拖慢全球科技领域的创新。
vocabulary.newsContext: 科技打压新闻中指出贸易限制会阻碍创新（innovation）与发展。

vocabulary.example: The woman was able to discard her wheelchair and walk on her own.
vocabulary.translation: 这位女士得以扔掉轮椅，独立行走。
vocabulary.newsContext: 外骨骼机器人新闻中描述患者 discard her wheelchair 的细节。

vocabulary.example: APEC economies were urged to uphold multilateralism in the technology sector.
vocabulary.translation: 亚太经合组织各经济体被呼吁在科技领域维护多边主义。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 APEC economies urged to deepen cooperation 中的表述。

vocabulary.example: New legal safeguards will protect cultural heritage from being damaged.
vocabulary.translation: 新的法律保障措施将保护文化遗产免遭破坏。
vocabulary.newsContext: 文化遗产新闻中提到 legal safeguards（法律保障）。

pattern.pattern: sb. was able to do sth. with the help of sth.（某人在某物的帮助下得以做成某事）
pattern.example: A British woman was able to discard her wheelchair and walk with the help of a Chinese-made exoskeleton robot.
pattern.translation: 一位英国女性在中国制造的外骨骼机器人的帮助下，得以扔掉轮椅重新行走。
pattern.usage: 用于描述借助某种技术、工具或他人帮助而完成原本困难的事情。也可替换为 be able to do sth. thanks to sth.。

grammar.title: 新闻标题中的被动语态与不定式被动结构（to be + 过去分词）
grammar.explanation: 英文新闻标题常省略助动词，使用被动语态突出动作承受者；'to be + 过去分词' 表示"将被……"的动作，强调计划、安排或将要发生的被动行为。例如 "Cultural heritage protection to be bolstered" 实际是 "Cultural heritage protection is to be bolstered"。
examples: Cultural heritage protection to be bolstered over the next five years.
APEC economies urged to deepen cooperation and unlock new growth momentum.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 skel 上；exo- 读作 /ˈeksəʊ/，中间的元音要轻快，-skeleton 读作 /ˈskelɪtn/，注意 'l' 与 't' 之间元音弱化为 /ɪ/，结尾音节含成音节 /tn/。整体节奏是：轻-轻-重-轻。
examples: The exoskeleton robot helped the patient walk again.
Chinese-made exoskeleton devices drew huge crowds at the trade fair.

reading.title: When Technology Gives People Back Their Steps
reading.content:
At the China Import and Export Fair, a British woman arrived in a wheelchair and left on her own two feet. Suffering from hindered mobility after a stroke, she tried a Chinese-made exoskeleton robot and was able to discard her wheelchair within minutes. Her story, shared widely as part of the "China Haul" trend, shows how wearable technology is moving from laboratories into everyday life.

Observers say such breakthroughs reflect years of systematic investment in innovation. However, the US crackdown on technology, including restrictions on chip exports, is seen as counterproductive, as it slows global innovation and disrupts supply chains.

Experts urge economies to uphold multilateralism and unlock new growth momentum through open cooperation. Whether it is a robot restoring mobility or digital tools safeguarding cultural heritage, advanced technology works best when it serves people rather than political interests.
reading.translation:
在中国进出口交易会上，一位乘坐轮椅而来的英国女性靠自己的双腿离开了现场。中风后行动不便的她试用了中国制造的外骨骼机器人，几分钟内便得以扔掉轮椅。她的故事作为"中国购物潮"的一部分被广泛传播，展示了可穿戴技术正如何从实验室走进日常生活。

观察人士称，这类突破反映了多年来对创新的系统性投入。然而，美国对科技的打压（包括限制芯片出口）被认为适得其反，因为它拖慢了全球创新、扰乱了供应链。

专家呼吁各经济体维护多边主义，通过开放合作释放新的增长动能。无论是恢复行动能力的机器人，还是保护文化遗产的数字工具，先进的科技只有服务于人而非政治利益时，才能发挥最大价值。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily 今日新闻 'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out、US crackdown on tech counterproductive、Cultural heritage protection to be bolstered 与 APEC economies urged to deepen cooperation 改写。
